_comment: Expression -> engine settings. chatterbox: [exaggeration 0.25-1.2, cfg_weight 0.2-0.7] (more exaggeration = more expressive, lower cfg = slower and freer). strong = expressions where an introvert adjustment is not applied. intense = expressions acted with the expressive Qwen style. sanitize = direction words replaced before acting (regex, replacement).

qwen.style: Natural, believable voice acting; grounded, not exaggerated; adult voices only.
qwen.intense_style: Expressive, emotionally intense voice acting; fully committed performance, adult voice.
